description: Persisted-setting round trip for the user-adjustable parallelReadDenylist (design §F / AGENTS.md Persisted Setting Checklist): complete the storage-to-webview path in ClineProvider + webviewMessageHandler, and add the cachedState-bound SettingsView exclusions control with its binding/save test. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST, mergeReadDenylist, ExtensionState key). Makes FEAT-002's effective-config read return the merged user value instead of the static default.
steps: In src/core/webview/ClineProvider.ts: add a getEffectiveReadDenylist() helper that calls mergeReadDenylist(storedParallelReadDenylist, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST); return parallelReadDenylist from getState() with unset -> merge-over-default semantics; add parallelReadDenylist to BOTH the destructuring AND the returned object of getStateToPostToWebview() so a saved value does not visually revert (checklist step).

In src/core/webview/webviewMessageHandler.ts persist parallelReadDenylist via the generic contextProxy.setValue() path (schema-validated at the persistence boundary; no special normalization), matching the parallelCapacityMap handling.

In webview-ui/src/components/settings/ add an advanced 'Parallel read exclusions' control that reads and writes LOCAL cachedState (NOT live useExtensionState()) per the Settings View Pattern, and include parallelReadDenylist in the updateSettings payload emitted by SettingsView.handleSubmit(). Follow the existing advanced-setting control/section pattern in the SettingsView tree.

Add a webview-ui test under webview-ui/src/components/settings/__tests__/ asserting the control binds to cachedState and the Save handler emits parallelReadDenylist in the updateSettings payload, for both a set value and a cleared-category value.

Add an extension-host test asserting ClineProvider.getStateToPostToWebview() returns the saved parallelReadDenylist (both default/unset -> merged default, and cleared-category cases). Place it with the existing ClineProvider tests under src/core/webview/__tests__/.

Run `pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0` on ClineProvider.ts, webviewMessageHandler.ts and the new provider test, and `pnpm --dir webview-ui exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0` on the new/edited SettingsView files and the webview test; confirm no suppression-count increase. No `as any`, no floating promises.
acceptance_criteria: ClineProvider.getStateToPostToWebview() returns parallelReadDenylist; unset yields the merged DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST and a cleared-category value survives the round trip (AC-6/AC-7 at the persistence boundary).
A parallelReadDenylist that clears the typings category causes a vendored .d.ts read to be allowed at runtime (via FEAT-002's effective-config read); the default (unset) still denies it (AC-6).
The SettingsView control binds to cachedState (not live state) and the Save payload includes parallelReadDenylist.
The webview-ui binding/save test and the ClineProvider getStateToPostToWebview test both pass.
verification: pnpm --dir webview-ui exec vitest run src/components/settings/__tests__
pnpm --dir src exec vitest run core/webview/__tests__
pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 core/webview/ClineProvider.ts core/webview/webviewMessageHandler.ts
findings:
Persisted round trip complete; the parallelReadDenylist setting now flows storage -> runtime -> webview and back. All FEAT-003 verification suites pass: webview-ui src/components/settings/__tests__ = 425 green (6 new); src core/webview/__tests__/ClineProvider.spec.ts = 195 green (3 new). ESLint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 clean on every edited file; src/eslint-suppressions.json and webview-ui suppressions unchanged. packages/types tsc --noEmit passes. NOTE: core/webview/__tests__/webviewMessageHandler.* and generateSystemPrompt.spec.ts fail in this environment, but that is PRE-EXISTING (verified on the clean baseline via git stash) and caused by the `../../activate/observatory` dynamic import, not FEAT-003.

== src/core/webview/ClineProvider.ts ==
- Imports: added `type GlobalSettings` and `DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST` from '@roo-code/types', and `mergeReadDenylist, type ReadDenylistConfig` from '../../services/glob/readDenylist'.
- getEffectiveReadDenylist(stored): ReadDenylistConfig = mergeReadDenylist(stored, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST) — the single merge point (per-field replace-over-default; unset = byte-for-byte default; []=clear category).
- getEffectiveReadDenylistForWebview(stored): shapes the merged (readonly) config into fresh MUTABLE string arrays matching GlobalSettings['parallelReadDenylist'] (ExtensionState field type), avoiding a readonly->mutable assignability error.
- getState(): returns the RAW stored value `parallelReadDenylist: stateValues.parallelReadDenylist` (undefined when unset) — matches the parallelCapacityMap precedent; runtime consumers merge.
- getStateToPostToWebview(): added `parallelReadDenylist` to BOTH the destructuring (from `await this.getState()`) AND the returned object as `this.getEffectiveReadDenylistForWebview(parallelReadDenylist)` so the control renders the EFFECTIVE exclusions and a cleared category survives (unset -> merged default; globs:[] -> globs:[] with other fields defaulted).

== src/core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts (FEAT-002's resolveReadControls effective-config read site) ==
- resolveReadControls now resolves the effective denylist from provider state: `const state = await provider.getState(); denylist = mergeReadDenylist(state.parallelReadDenylist, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST)`. Falls back to DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST when no provider is attached. Merges INLINE via mergeReadDenylist (not provider.getEffectiveReadDenylist) so existing ReadFileTool test mocks that only stub getState() keep working. budgetBytes still DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES (budget is not user-adjustable in this FEAT). This makes a cleared typings category allow a vendored .d.ts read at runtime (AC-6/AC-7).

== src/core/webview/webviewMessageHandler.ts ==
- NO EDIT NEEDED. The generic updateSettings loop already persists every key via `contextProxy.setValue(key, newValue)` with no special-casing for parallelReadDenylist, exactly matching the parallelCapacityMap handling. Schema validation at the persistence boundary (parallelReadDenylistSchema) is the only normalization.

== webview-ui/src/components/settings/OmniRouteSettings.tsx ==
- Added the 'Parallel read exclusions' advanced control as a sibling block (Block 0b) of the parallel-capacity editor (fleet-wide, NOT gated on isOmniRoute). Four VSCodeTextArea controls (one per category: vendoredDirs, rootDirs, files, globs), newline-delimited entries, data-testid `parallel-read-exclusions-<field>`.
- Binds to LOCAL cachedState: reads `parallelReadDenylist?.[field]` prop, writes via `updateDenylistField` -> `setCachedStateField('parallelReadDenylist', next)`. Each edit trims lines, drops blanks; emptying a textarea writes an explicit [] (per-field replace => clears that category downstream).
- Added local `textareaValue(event)` helper (typed, no `as any`) mirroring FilePatternAllowlist to read the toolkit textarea value. Added `type GlobalSettings` import and `ParallelReadDenylist = NonNullable<GlobalSettings['parallelReadDenylist']>` type + `parallelReadDenylist?` prop.

== webview-ui/src/components/settings/SettingsView.tsx ==
- Destructures `parallelReadDenylist` from cachedState; passes it to OmniRouteSettings; includes `parallelReadDenylist: parallelReadDenylist ?? {}` in the handleSubmit updateSettings payload (mirrors parallelCapacityMap).

== webview-ui/src/i18n/locales/en/settings.json ==
- Added omniroute.parallelReadExclusions { label, hint, fields.{vendoredDirs,rootDirs,files,globs} }.

== Tests ==
- webview-ui OmniRouteSettings.spec.tsx: +4 tests (renders one textarea per category always-visible; seeds from cachedState; writes a trimmed/blank-filtered array; emptying writes [] to clear). renderSettings extended with a parallelReadDenylist option.
- webview-ui SettingsView.spec.tsx: +2 handleSubmit payload tests (edited category appears in updateSettings; cleared category [] round-trips). The shared VSCodeTextArea mock was extended to also forward `onInput` (additive, no existing test relied on it) so the exclusions control's onInput fires under the mock.
- src ClineProvider.spec.ts: +3 tests (unset -> getState raw undefined + webview merged DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST; cleared globs:[] -> getState {globs:[]} + webview merged-with-cleared; a saved override replaces provided categories and inherits omitted ones). Imported DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST.

NOT touched: timeout-config.ts, routeCapacityMap.ts/scheduler, the 64k reader cap, 1800s timeouts, taskLifecycle.ts. No .changeset/CHANGELOG edits.
